clock_note: decision_poll_ts is a SCHEDULE LABEL; causal_from is published_at (or receipt_ts, flagged as degraded). A chain quote in the decision minute normally PREDATES publication and proves coverage only.
identity_note: ml_option_chain_snapshots carries no instrument key, so identity is the tuple (session_date, index_key, expiry, strike, option_type); an incomplete tuple is unjoinable, never guessed
population_note: reported intent != admissible proposal != actual Paper position. These exports contain NO actual Paper positions.
supersession_note: `decisions` is EVERY authority decision, including NEUTRAL and UNAVAILABLE ones. A pending entry is superseded if any newer decision for that index was published before the fill.
